description: Render a multi-page-safe, publication-grade Invoice or Receipt PDF from structured JSON with deterministic 10^6-scaled BigInt fixed-point totals, optional company logo, and offline vector payment QR codes via POST /v1/pdf/invoice ($0.010 USDC via x402). Saves the compiled PDF locally to output_pdf_path, includes a 15-minute shareable download_url when returned by the server, and returns 150-DPI PNG page previews as native MCP image/png blocks by default.

amount_paid.description: Optional amount already paid toward total

currency.description: ISO 4217 or crypto currency code (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY', 'USDC'; default 'USD')

discount_amount.description: Optional fixed discount amount (mutually exclusive with discount_percent)

discount_percent.description: Optional percentage discount (0..100, mutually exclusive with discount_amount)

include_page_previews.description: Render 150-DPI PNG page previews and return them as native MCP image/png content blocks for visual inspection (default true)

line_items.description: 1..200 invoice line items with description, unit_price (number or up-to-6-decimal string), and optional quantity (default 1)

logo_base64.description: Optional PNG or JPEG company logo encoded as 'base64:...' or raw base64 (max 1 MB decoded)

logo_path.description: Optional local PNG/JPEG logo file path inside TEX402_ALLOWED_ROOT (or cwd) to read safely and encode as base64:...

notes.description: Optional customer-facing notes or thank-you message

output_pdf_path.description: Required local '.pdf' file path inside TEX402_ALLOWED_ROOT (or cwd) or os.tmpdir() where the rendered invoice PDF will be saved

output_preview_dir.description: Optional local directory inside TEX402_ALLOWED_ROOT (or cwd) or os.tmpdir() where rendered 150-DPI PNG page previews (page-1.png, ...) will also be written

payment_instructions.description: Optional payment instructions (bank wire/ACH details, wallet_address/network, and optional payment_url or qr_data for crisp offline vector QR code rendering)

status.description: Invoice payment status badge ('unpaid' default, 'paid', 'draft', 'overdue', or 'void')

theme.description: Invoice typographic theme: 'clean' (SaaS default), 'ledger' (accounting/enterprise serif), 'minimal' (Swiss grid), or 'web3' (crypto/x402 on-chain settlement)

name: tex402_invoice
title: TeX402 JSON Invoice to PDF
